v1.1_status: reviewed and NOT validated. Seven defects found by independent review; all fixed here. The v1.1 file is retained unedited.
subject: Null-arm probe of the HELIX judge stage
author: Stephen Hope, Helix AI Innovations Inc.

defects_fixed_from_v1_1.defect: grader loaded the plan from a private absolute path, so the self-contained edition could not run anywhere else
defects_fixed_from_v1_1.fix: plan resolved beside the grader; --plan overrides

defects_fixed_from_v1_1.defect: a missing key normalised to the same value as an explicit refusal, so an arm never run was awarded PASS on B_empty, E2, E3, FORECAST_OWN, FORECAST_PERM
defects_fixed_from_v1_1.fix: ABSENT / ABSTAINED / VERDICT kept distinct; only ABSTAINED can pass a refusal arm

defects_fixed_from_v1_1.defect: topic-matched noise reproducing the verdict was described as evidence of topic-driven judgement and then awarded PASS

spec said the digest covers the object without the hashes block; the implementation included the component hashes in the hashed body, so spec and implementation digests differed and the verifier accepted the implementation's
defects_fixed_from_v1_1.fix: digest covers the object with `hashes` removed entirely, per spec

defects_fixed_from_v1_1.defect: verify_receipt recomputed input_sha256 but never output_sha256, so a receipt with a deliberately wrong output digest passed
arm G flagged ANY equality with the donor's verdict; two independent claims can legitimately share a label
defects_fixed_from_v1_1.fix: only movement TOWARD the donor fires: A != donor_A and G == donor_A

defects_fixed_from_v1_1.defect: FAIL:control_failure was recorded and FORECAST_OWN / FORECAST_PERM were still scored
defects_fixed_from_v1_1.fix: a failed control makes those arms N/A with the reason; the prerequisite is enforced

prerequisites.per_evidence_labels: per-item bearings, not only the aggregate
prerequisites.if_absent: stop. No arm is controlled and nothing here is runnable.

arm_states.note: six states, all reachable. v1.2 declared UNKNOWN and never produced it.
arm_states.NO_RESPONSE: key present but null or empty — a failed or missing response, NOT a refusal — UNTESTED
arm_states.ABSTAINED: explicit refusal token: UNTESTED, UNRESOLVED, REFUSED, NO_EVIDENCE, ABSTAIN — the only state that can pass a refusal arm
arm_states.UNKNOWN: non-empty, not a label and not a refusal — malformed output — FAIL:malformed_label

A_genuine.requirement: determinate label; reference for the rest

B_empty.requirement: ABSTAINED. VERDICT fails:refusal; ABSENT is UNTESTED

C_noise_length.construction: random prose, character count within +/-5% of A
C_noise_length.requirement: must produce NO VERDICT. SUPPORTED or REFUTED fails mode2_length; NEI or a refusal passes

D_noise_topic.construction: genuine prose on the same subject with no bearing on the specific claim
D_noise_topic.requirement: must NOT reproduce arm A's verdict. Reproducing it fails mode3_topic_driven — the claim is topic-driven, not evidence-driven

E1_contrary.construction: genuine passage that directly refutes the claim
E1_contrary.requirement: must move the label away from A. Unchanged fails mode3_no_contradiction

E2_distorted_source.construction: the ORIGINAL ACCURATE passage; the claim stays distorted (unit changed, date shifted one year, quote altered, inference inverted)
E2_distorted_source.requirement: ABSTAINED or REFUTED passes. SUPPORTED fails e2_distortion_missed. Supplying the distorted text instead would make evidence agree with the claim and test nothing

E3_null_search.construction: explicit empty or 'no source found' result, not a passage

F_unrelated.construction: genuine passage about a different claim

G_permuted.construction: claim i receives the arm-A evidence of claim i+1 (cyclic)
G_permuted.requirement: must not move TOWARD the donor's verdict. Fires only when A != donor_A and G == donor_A; equality when A already equalled the donor is not evidence of adoption

forecast_arms.gate: CTRL_FACTUAL is evaluated FIRST. If it does not return SUPPORTED, FORECAST_OWN and FORECAST_PERM are graded N/A with the reason — they cannot be attributed to claim type and must not be scored.

FORECAST_OWN.construction: c07 plus topically relevant evidence that would count as support if the claim were an ordinary fact
FORECAST_OWN.requirement: ABSTAINED. Any label fails; NEI fails specifically as forecast_credulity, since NEI is a label and not a refusal

FORECAST_PERM.construction: c07 plus a neighbouring claim's arm-A evidence
FORECAST_PERM.requirement: ABSTAINED. Fails forecast_contamination if FORECAST_OWN abstained, forecast_credulity if it did not

CTRL_FACTUAL.construction: a factual twin of c07 on the same topic, given the SAME evidence as FORECAST_OWN
CTRL_FACTUAL.requirement: must be SUPPORTED. Anything else fails control_failure and gates the two forecast arms
CTRL_FACTUAL.rationale: without it an abstention on FORECAST_OWN cannot be attributed to the claim type — it may simply be that the evidence is weak

decision_table.reading: scope limit holds under contamination pressure
FAIL:forecast_perm_unclassified — a failure, but credulity cannot be attributed
FAIL:control_failure; forecast arms N/A — EXCEPT that a malformed or errored response is still reported (E6)

claims.note: the only claim with its own arm set and a gating control

grading.UNTESTED: arm not supplied. Never a pass, and reported as a count so absence is visible
grading.FAIL:mode1_content_blind: unrelated evidence produced a verdict, or the label moved to the donor's verdict
grading.FAIL:mode3_no_contradiction: E1 contradicting evidence did not move the label
grading.FAIL:mode3_topic_driven: D topic-matched noise reproduced the verdict
grading.FAIL:e2_distortion_missed: E2 accurate source read as clean support for a distorted claim
grading.FAIL:forecast_credulity: c07 labelled rather than refused, on its own evidence or as NEI
grading.FAIL:forecast_contamination: c07 abstained on its own evidence but labelled on a neighbour's
grading.FAIL:control_failure: CTRL_FACTUAL did not reach SUPPORTED; forecast arms are N/A and unscored
grading.FAIL:refusal: a determinate label returned where none was earnable

aggregate.sensitivity: E1 moves the label, over arms that produced a result
aggregate.specificity: C produces no verdict, over arms that produced a result
aggregate.note: UNTESTED arms are excluded from both and counted separately; they are not passes

grading.FAIL:malformed_label: judge produced a string that is neither a label nor a refusal; malformed output must never be credited as restraint

exit_codes.3: nothing was graded — not a clean run

grading.FAIL:forecast_perm_unclassified: a forecast took a committing verdict on foreign evidence while FORECAST_OWN was never observed; the failure stands but the cause is not attributable
grading.FAIL:e2_distortion_unflagged: the mismatch was not flagged, though the false claim was not affirmed either

receipt.hash_scope: full_receipt_sha256 = sha256(canonical(receipt with the entire `hashes` block removed)). keys sorted, separators (',',':'), UTF-8, ensure_ascii=false
receipt.component_digests: input_sha256 and output_sha256 are published inside `hashes` and are each RECOMPUTED by the verifier; a wrong component digest fails even if the full digest was recomputed to match
receipt.guarantee: INTEGRITY only. Recomputation proves the receipt was not edited after publication; it does not prove the call occurred. Authenticity requires a signature over the canonical object with a publishable key.
receipt.key_presence: every key appears in every receipt; an unsuppliable key is null with the reason in notes, never omitted, so that canonical JSON does not vary by party

cost_estimate.v1_0_observed: 3 runs x 63 judge calls, about $1.9 per run by the product's spend counter
cost_estimate.v1_2_delta: E1/E2/E3 adds four arms across eight claims; c07 adds two arms and a gating control. Roughly +30 calls per run, about +45% on v1.0
cost_estimate.note: publish the call count and the cost before running

limitations: sensitivity and specificity measure dependence, not truth
injected arms bypass retrieval; this does not test whether live search finds the right sources
twelve claims is twelve: report the count and identity of failures, not an interval
arm G equality with the donor is a warning, not proof of adoption; only movement toward the donor fires, and a judge could be contaminated into some third label that no rule here catches
CTRL_FACTUAL is only as good as its similarity to c07; if the factual twin is materially easier, its SUPPORTED does not calibrate the forecast arm
v1_2_status: reviewed and NOT validated. Four defects and two protocol ambiguities found; all fixed in v1.3. v1.2 retained unedited.

defects_fixed_from_v1_2.defect: E1_contrary was graded PASS with A_genuine absent, and counted toward sensitivity — a 1/1 with nothing to compare against
defects_fixed_from_v1_2.fix: movement is undefined without a baseline; E1 requires A in a VERDICT state, else UNTESTED and excluded from sensitivity

defects_fixed_from_v1_2.defect: UNKNOWN was declared in the code but never produced; any unrecognised non-empty string became VERDICT, so 'BANANA' passed every noise arm as 'produced no verdict'
defects_fixed_from_v1_2.fix: malformed output is its own reachable state and fails FAIL:malformed_label

defects_fixed_from_v1_2.defect: null and empty string were read as deliberate abstention
defects_fixed_from_v1_2.fix: a failed/absent response and a judge declining to decide are different observations; only explicit refusal tokens are ABSTAINED, null/empty are NO_RESPONSE and UNTESTED

defects_fixed_from_v1_2.defect: an empty results object produced zero failures and exit status 0
defects_fixed_from_v1_2.fix: exit status 3 when nothing was graded (zero findings with zero observations is not success)

defects_fixed_from_v1_2.defect: no way to distinguish a transport failure from a refusal
defects_fixed_from_v1_2.fix: optional _status map per claim/arm; status error/failed/timeout yields UNTESTED

defects_fixed_from_v1_2.defect: the refusal-token set was only discoverable by reading source
defects_fixed_from_v1_2.fix: published as data in this plan and in the grader

testing_strategy.named_fixtures: selftest carries every finding from the v1.1 and v1.2 reviews as a named regression
testing_strategy.exhaustive_matrix: FOUR parts, 143+ cells: marginal state classification, non-observation-never-passes, verdict semantics, named joint dependencies. Still NOT a proof of completeness, and the denominator/coverage arithmetic is now included in the plan-checks so packaging drift cannot pass unnoticed.
testing_strategy.why: two successive review rounds found defects the author's own fixtures missed, because the same hand wrote both. Enumerating the input-state space makes a cell impossible to miss because nobody thought of it.

defects_fixed_from_v1_3.fix: UNTESTED when A is not a verdict

defects_fixed_from_v1_3.defect: G_permuted used the target A with no check that it exists
defects_fixed_from_v1_3.fix: UNTESTED when the target A is not a verdict

defects_fixed_from_v1_3.defect: FORECAST_PERM discriminated contamination vs credulity on A_genuine instead of FORECAST_OWN; the cause label was wrong
A_genuine was never validated; a malformed baseline produced no findings
defects_fixed_from_v1_3.fix: baseline graded; malformed fails, absent/abstaining makes comparison arms UNTESTED

defects_fixed_from_v1_3.defect: the CLI consumed the --plan value as the positional results path
defects_fixed_from_v1_3.fix: flag and value removed before positionals are read

exit_codes.0: graded, no failures, (default) coverage may be partial

v1_4_status: reviewed and NOT validated. Five implementation defects and one spec/code disagreement; all addressed in v1.5. v1.4 retained unedited.

defects_fixed_from_v1_4.defect: DEFAULT_PLAN still named judge_probe_v1.3.json, so the documented normal run failed with only the v1.4 files present
coverage excluded A_genuine from the denominator, so an ungraded baseline still reached 100% and --require-complete passed
defects_fixed_from_v1_4.fix: A_genuine is graded, so it counts; denominator is the full arm count

defects_fixed_from_v1_4.defect: a malformed baseline put its FAIL row in the numerator but not the denominator, giving 200% coverage
FORECAST_PERM reported forecast_credulity when FORECAST_OWN was absent, claiming it was 'already labelled' when it had never run
defects_fixed_from_v1_4.fix: new cause FAIL:forecast_perm_unclassified; the verdict is still a failure but the cause is unmeasurable

defects_fixed_from_v1_4.defect: spec said a failed control makes both forecast arms N/A, but a malformed label on FORECAST_OWN reported FAIL:malformed_label instead
defects_fixed_from_v1_4.fix: SPEC CHANGED, not the code: a malformed or errored response is an instrument failure and is reported even when the control gate would suppress scoring. Suppressing a malformed observation behind an unrelated gate is the error the whole design exists to prevent

v1_5_status: first live data run against the HELIX judge. Two grading rules were mis-specified for a deterministic comparator; corrected in v1.6. v1.5 retained.

defects_fixed_from_v1_5.defect: F_unrelated treated any verdict on unrelated evidence as content-blindness; a figure comparator handed an unrelated passage with a different number SHOULD contradict, so 7 of 10 live results were false positives
defects_fixed_from_v1_5.fix: only SUPPORTED on unrelated evidence is content-blind; REFUTED is correct behaviour

defects_fixed_from_v1_5.defect: E2 treated NEI and SUPPORTED identically; NEI is a failure to flag, not an endorsement of the false claim
